one_liner: Paygent Connect is the marketplace/platform product of the gopaygent.com payments gateway. It has a REST API with bearer API keys, webhooks, a sandbox and a 'free plan'. The full API reference and pricing were not in the fetched pages.
access_notes: The homepage says "No credit card required. Free plan available." and lists a sandbox test environment. The draft's pricing quotes ($15/mo gateway, $0.10 per transaction, free sandbox) are not in the fetched pages, so they are unverified. Merchant underwriting for live processing is not confirmed. A separate page describes wholesale and partner revenue-share onboarding, which is a different path.
blocker_notes: The docs page (gopaygent.com/developers/docs) was not fetched, so the endpoint list is unknown. The Connect API surface is not documented in the pages. Live processing likely needs a merchant account or paid gateway, but this is unverified. The paygent.to, withpaygent.com and paygent.ai pages are unrelated products and should be ignored. The draft's MCP evidence (npm.io) is not in the fetched pages.

evidence.quote: Clean, predictable, and fully documented REST APIs for every payment workflow.
No credit card required. Free plan available.
Full-featured test environment to simulate any payment scenario.
Real-time event notifications with retry logic and delivery guarantees.
Build marketplace payments, revenue sharing, and automated onboarding with Paygent Connect.
